schema_note: This is a proposed Own8 data schema, not an official NFL depth-chart taxonomy. The tier names Starter/2nd/3rd/4th/Unknown are project labels and must be backed by an explicit dated team source. The rows below describe fields to collect; they do not assert current players, injuries, or depth order.

offensive_groups.project_scope: C/G/T and any source-listed OL position

defensive_groups.project_scope: DT/NT and other source-listed defensive-line positions; preserve official position
DE/EDGE only when source-listed; do not remap without an explicit rule
LB; preserve official position and role source

fields.purpose: Join schedule, injury report, lineup, outcome, and forecast to the same official NFL game.
fields.verification_rule: Match the official schedule/game page; retain season and week. Reject a response whose returned week does not match the requested week.
fields.status: UNKNOWN — no Week 11 injury report verified

fields.purpose: Stable identity to avoid name-only joins and team/position ambiguity.
fields.verification_rule: Use the official team/player page and preserve the exact position field from the specific official report; do not translate or infer position groups without a documented mapping.
fields.status: SCHEMA ONLY — no current player rows entered

fields.purpose: Separate offensive and defensive replacement coverage and measure missing groups.
fields.verification_rule: Own8 taxonomy field; preserve source-listed position alongside it. Unknown mappings stay blank and flagged.

fields.purpose: Prove which report version was available at forecast cutoff.
fields.verification_rule: Store the page's stated report date/time where present and the retrieval time separately; preserve the exact URL and response week. If either is unknown, keep the cutoff status unknown.

fields.purpose: Represent the official report without translating it into a model's own health judgment.
fields.verification_rule: Copy only the official report's displayed fields and labels. Blank stays blank; practice status is not game clearance.
fields.status: UNKNOWN FOR CURRENT WEEK — report request returned Week 10

fields.purpose: Record a final official availability signal when an official source provides one.
fields.verification_rule: Use a dated official game/club source; do not infer active status from a practice designation, injury report omission, or expected starter claim.
fields.status: NOT CAPTURED — source route and current value require verification

fields.purpose: Represent the requested starter / 2nd / 3rd / 4th string role as an explicit relationship.
fields.verification_rule: Own8 labels only. Require a dated official depth chart or explicit official team lineup source that identifies the role. If the team source is absent or ambiguous, store Unknown/null; never infer from roster order or injury report ordering.

fields.purpose: Link a replacement to the unavailable or displaced role and record the source-backed reason.
fields.verification_rule: Only populate when a dated official chart/announcement links the players or a verified official game source identifies the starter/replacement. Do not create the link from a model assumption.

fields.purpose: Measure exposure before interpreting stats as player or unit quality.
fields.verification_rule: Choose a specific official NFL/NGS field and unit; collect its historical coverage and game-level alignment. If snaps/participation or an equivalent official measure cannot be verified for the feature, leave it blank.
fields.status: UNVERIFIED — no current workload data in this review

fields.purpose: Support a defensible unit-strength adjustment, not a label based only on roster tier.
fields.verification_rule: Pre-register outcome/metric, baseline, context, minimum evidence/precision rule, and chronological test. Store the estimate and uncertainty only after the data and method pass; otherwise null.
fields.status: BLOCKED — no estimate or uncertainty computed
